newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton to buy assets of NJ builder.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton to buy assets of NJ builder.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire substantially all of the New Jersey assets of SGS Communities Inc, a builder and developer of single-family homes.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The assets to be acquired include a backlog of homes under contract, which totaled about $34.5 million as of August 31. The company said the acquisition would not include any of SGS Communities' assets in Florida.
SGS Communities operates in five New Jersey counties: Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth, Ocean and Essex.
